title: A beautiful experience
text: A beautiful experience, the guide was always attentive, he changed our day due to an indisposition, there were snacks and drinks, beautiful views, and the water was transparent. A beautiful experience
author: yolandafK3530TY

title: Amazing experience
text: Absolutely fabulous experience,  Alberto was an amazing skipper nothing was too much to help , very friendly and informative.  The views were incredible and the icing on the cake was pulling into a sheltered bay and snorkeling with the amazing array of fish all around the bay . I did this last year and had the same experience,  hence I came back this year . I can't recommend this experiance enough and will definitely do it again next year .
author: Clemm109

title: Highly recommended experience
text: A super recommended experience. The captain was very attentive at all times, offering us snacks and drinks throughout the journey. We were able to stop to go snorkeling. We were lucky to see dolphins. A very pleasant walk with wonderful views. 10 out of 10!
author: N4718YProc_og

title: Can highly recommend!
text: The captain was very sympathetic and took good care of the whole family. We saw dolphins and it became an unforgettable end of a fantastic holiday in Almuñecar.
author: camsmoli

title: Great Morning 🐬🐬🐬
text: It was a surreal experience with dolphins swimming by the side of the boat. The captain brought us swimming in crystal clear waters, and he was a great host with information and snacks!
author: Patrice_K

title: A very pleasant trip to...
text: A very pleasant trip at sunset; they serve drinks and snacks. The captain was attentive to our needs at all times and very kind.
author: Maria_G

title: Great excursion
text: We had booked at very short notice in the late evening of the previous day and were allowed to start this great trip as a threesome. Alberto was super nice, made for us an extra slender, so we had another touching encounter with a dolphin group to the great trip. Highly recommended!!!
author: Heike_R

title: A perfect way to spend an afternoon
text: Alberto was a fantastic skipper and host, so friendly and knowledgeable about the area. The yacht is beautiful and Alberto ensured we were comfortable and drinks and snacks were provided. We saw beautiful scenery and were also lucky enough to spot some dolphins! Highly recommended and well worth the money. Gracias Alberto, we will definitely be back for another trip 🙂⛵
author: juliecV5679DX

title: Great way to see the coast!
text: We had a wonderful sailing outing with Alberto. He was very knowledgeable and friendly. His boat was in great condition and provided some nice snacks and cava. He had snorkeling gear and a paddleboard for a nice time in the water. We did not see dolphins this time of year, but we did not expect that. Overall, I recommend his sailing cruise and 3 hours was perfect.
author: Brandon_K

title: Good atmosphere, beautiful trip and nice boat.
text: Nice boat trip, with a captain who was skillful and pleasant. Beautiful nature and good atmosphere. Recommended. There was the opportunity to jump in the water and snorkel. Beautiful water
